component.licence: Unknown. No licence or author is stated in the file or in Handheld Companion. It is redistributed here unmodified, as Handheld Companion bundles it.
notes: KX.exe is unsigned and has no version resource, so the SHA-256 is the only identity.
WSGM runs it only for the user-selected KX power path on Intel handhelds; each command loads and unloads HwRwDrv.
KX reports the value it read or wrote as its exit code; a nonzero exit is not a failure.
